rtsom sgyur tshogs chung /gtso 'gan rtsom sgyur pa/dge bshes lhag rdogrtsom sgyur las rogs/bstan na tshe dpagbstan na bserdzod nams/tshe ring sa skyabs/a cabya pad+ma rdo rje/'od 'gyur bskyar zhib pa/dge bshes lhag rdor/skyes sar klu sgrub/
gleng gzhi/da༅༅/ /7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen yo mchog gis mdzad pa'i rdul snyed lajig rten/sems don dang tshan rig 'phrad pa zhes pa'i dpe deb 'di ni rgyal spyi'i nang dri med lung rigs kyis brgyan pa'i khong gi tshan rig dang 'brel ba'i phul byung gi rang rnam grags chen zhig yin/ deb 'di'i nang khong gis tshan rig dang sems don 'phrad mtshams kyi 'du 'dzoms 'di'i thog mgon po gang gi dgongs par mnga' ba'i dgos gal shin tu che zhing / dus rabs dang 'tshams pa'i gnad don rnams lhug por go bskon gsed 'grol gnang yod/ 'dir 'khod kyi gzhi rtsa'i gnad don dang dri ba khag ni sems dang tshe srog gi tshogs 'du thengs bcu bzhi pa de'i thog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen 4 mchog dang / tshan rig pa tsho khag gcig /nang pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' bcas kyi dbar tshan rig dang sems don gyi sgo nas nga tsho'i 'dzam gling 'dir zhabs zhu ji ltar sgrub thub tshul gyi gleng gzhi gtso bo de chags yod/deb 'di'i nang rigs gsar tshan rig dar rgyas dang de'i 'phral phugs kyi bskul rkyen che ba la brten nas/ 7gong sa mchog nas blang dor dang / lta grub/ gzugs 'das kyi chos bcas the ba'i thun mong dang thun yong ma yin pa'i gna' deng gi shes bya'i rnam grangs skor la gleng gnang yod/ dper na/ shes bya shes pa'i thabs mi bslu ba tshan rig kho na yin nam zhes bka' 'dri gnang 〈snad cing / des tshan rig gi shes bya'i mtha' mtshams dang / chung mthar cha gses ring lugs/ de'i nges med kyi 'bras bu glengags la bka' 'dri gnang gi yod pa ma zad/ 7gong sa mchog gi lung rig dang rnam dpyod kyi 'jug pa yangs shos tshan rig gi khyab khongs re re nang kun khyab sems khur dang blang dor khrigs chags kyi bya ba tshul bzhin bltar tshul thad dogs slong gnang ba de dag la'ang gzur gnas tshan rig pa rnams
71kyis lan 'debs shig 'tshol dgos kyi yod/ gzhan yang rigs rdzas dang 'dus rdul skye dngos rig pa yar rgyas phyin pa la brten nas skye dngos 'phrul rig gi bzo las gang sar khyab yod pa de dag bkol spyod dang lag bltar bya tshul de'i 'og nga tsho'i nyin re'i 'tsho ba'i nang 'jig rten kun spyod dang blang dor gyi gnad don dang 'brel ba'i 'gal dang ma nges pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom dang kha skyengs kyi gnas tshul mang dag cig 'phrad bzhin yod mod/ rdul phran dngos khams rig pa dang / yul rtogs tshan rig nang la'ang da dung de dang 'dra ba'i gzhi rtsa'i dka' rnyog mang so zhig gnas yod pa de dag gis lta grub dang / blang dod sems don gyi rnam gzhag sogs la do phog ci thebs kyi skor la phyi don dang nang don gnyis lnga'i don gnad gsal bar rtogs slad legs nyis dang yin min gyi go bsdur lhug por gnang yod/dngos khams rig pa dang / 'jig rten khams kyi rig pa/ dbang mtshan rig bcas kyi nang ha las pa'i yar rgyas mngon gsal dod yo phyin yod rung / nang sems kyi yon tan dang shes pa'i khyab tshad thog tshan rig gi bar stong chen yo zhig da dung lhag yod de/ dper na/ dbang rtsa'i tshan rig pa dag gis sems kyi rnam 'gyur ston par klad pa ni med du mi rung zhing / sems ni klad pa'i zhar byung dang mngon thon gyi khyad chos tsam yin par tshod dpag byas pa dang / dbang rtsa'i skye dngos rig pa dang klad rtsa'i tshan rig nas rnam shes kyi byung tshul 'grel bshad byas med cing / sems kyi rang gshis ni gzhan du 'gyur mi srid pa'i thun min zhig yin par tshod dpag byas pa lta bu tshan rig nas kha gsab bya dgos pa'i gnas tshul 'di rigs dang / tshad rdul dngos khams rig pa'am khon ṭam dngos khams rig pa dang / nang chos kyi rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngo 'o/ yul dngos so'i grub byed dang de'i cha shas/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin/ rten 'brel bltos grub kyi lta tshul bcas la 7gong sa mchog nas rtsal du bton gnang ste sgrub byed dang rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i sgo nas phyi rabs pa rnams la rin thang che ba'i dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gsar pa zhig bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnos par mdzad yod cing / khong gi brtsams chos 'di ni 'das pa'i lo ngo bcu phrag gsum lhag ring nang bstan mtshan nyid rig pa'i cha dang / de mthun tshan rig gi 'brel yod sde khag dbar la zhib 'jug dang spyangs bshad gnang ba'i don snying gting zab che ba'i grub don zhig yin
khi11pas gzur gnas blo ldan sus kyang blta klog dgos gal che zhing / 'di dag mtho rim slob gnyer sde tshan khag gi slob tshan nang 'jog thub pa byung na phan thogs shin tu che bar snang ngo /mtha' don/ khe na ḍar gnas sdod sku'i gsung sgyur thub bstan sbyin pa lags nas kho 'or deb 'di'i phab sgyur gyi 'gan blangs na legs tshul bskul ma gnang ba bzhin/ thog mar deb 'di'i rtsom sgyur tshogs chung gi tshogs mi re re'i ngos nas phab sgyur byas pa dang / de rjes gus nas bskyar zhib thengs mang byas rjes gal yo che la nan tan gyi tshul du skyes sar klu sgrub lags nas thog mtha' bar gsum du zhu dag gi grogs dan gnang ba dang / sod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rig gzhung nyams zhib 'gan 'dzin na ga sangs rgyas bstan dar lags dang / dha steng 'od khyim 'od dge slo bzang bstan dar rnam gnyis nas kyang 'od kyi brda sprod dang mthun min zhu dag dang bskyar zhib gnang ba/ slar yang tshan rig gi brda don rnams go bde khungs btsan yong slad 'di ga'i tshan rig sde tshan gyi las byed rkarma thub bstan lags dang bstan 'dzin dpal sgron lags gnyis nas mnyam du thengs gcig zhu dag gnang ba/ mjug tu tshan rig sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin nyi ma rgyal mtshan lags nas zhu dag zhib tshags thengs gcig btang nas 'dir 'khod tshan rig gi brda dang tha snyad rnams phyogs sdebs kyis deb 'di'i mjug tu zur bkol bgyis pa dang / 'di ga'i las byed bstan 'dzin mig dmar lags nas rgyab sha jus 'god gnang ba bcas dga' tshor chen sos yi rang dang rogs ram gnang mkhan gyi mi sna yongs la rtsom sgrig tshogs chung gi tshab zhus te snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'di nyid ni deng skabs tshan rig dang nang pa'i lta grub kyi gzhung lugs gting zab dang 'brel ba yod khar/ phab sgyur dang rtsom sgrig mkhan rnams kyi blo gros kyi mig dkyus la tshad gzung ldan pas/ dpyod ldan yid la gzan pa'i nongs pa re mchis tshe sor bcu'i 'dab mas snying lnga'i tshal yangs nas bshags par bgyi'o//rta sa bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi 'gan 'dzin ming khur ba dge bshes lhag rdor gyis phyi lo 2011 zla 4 tshes 20 la// //
mdzad pa po'i sngon gleng /da༅༅/ /nga rang tshan rig la dmigs bsal rgyung brdar yod mkhan zhig min/ ngas tshan rig skor phran bu shes pa phal mo che gtso so bdun re'i gsar deb ni'u se wig (7643 tshog006)dang / dbyin ji'i rgyang bsgrags lte gnas kyi 'dzam gling gsar 'phrin bhi bhi si (2 2 bu) nas byung ba'i gal che'i tshan rig gnas tshul gsar thon/ de min phyis su gnam rig skar dpyad slob deb 〈snags blta klog byas pa bcas las shes pa zhig yin/ 'das pa'i 〈sna ngo sum cu'i nang nga la tshan rig pa mi sger dang thug 'phrad bgro gleng byed pa'i go skabs gang mang byung / thug 'phrad de dag skabs ngas tshan rig pa'i bsam blo'i gzhi rtsa'i ma dpe dang / dpyad zhib byed tshul/ de bzhin rnam gzhag bye brag pa'am/ gsar rnyed de dag gi shugs rkyen bcas shes thabs la rtag tu 'bad brtson byas pa yin/ 'on kyang ngas de ltar tshan rig thog bsam blo gting zab btang ba de ni bden don gang yin shes par tshan rig gi shugs rkyen ci yod shes ched tsam min pag de bas gal che ba tshan rig la brten nas blang dor dang mi'i rin thang la shugs rkyen ji 'dra zhig thebs min gyi gnad don de yin/ 'das pa'i lo de dag nang ngos nas 'tshol zhib shugs che zugs bya yul gyi tshan rig gi sde tshan bye brag pa rnams ni/ phra rdul dngos khams rig pa dang / 'jig rten khams kyi rig pa/ dbang rtsa'i tshan rig dang / sems khams rig pa the ba'i skye dngos rig pa bcas yin/ nga'i shes rig gi sbyordzong brdar de nang pa'i lta tshul yin ltabs nang
527sa kyi 'dod tshul gal chen rnams dang tshan rig gi lta tshul gal chen khag gi dbar 'brel baji 'dra zhig yod dam snyam pa'i bsam blo yang yang 'khor myong / deb 'di de ltar bsam blo rgyunring dngor ba dang / 'od kyi nang pa'i dge 'dun pa zhig m+bu ba'i khang pa (656613 0627647ridang / rdul phran myur margya1gas gtong byed/ e phe/ em/ ar/ a yi/ (kha'akha1) byed las khablen slog dpar bcas kyi 'dzam gling nang shes yon gyi 'grul bzhud byas pa las byung ba zhigyin/rgya gar du skyabs bcol la slebs nas lo mang rjes/ de snga dus rabs bcu dgu pa'ilo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis 'od kyi nang bstan mkhasdbang tshor yongs grags su bskur ba'i gsung rtsom zhig mthong byung / dge 'dun chos 'phelni seskrotar sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa zhig yin par ma zad/ skabs der khong dang dus mnyam pa'i'od kyi mkhas pa gzhan las thun min gyi khyad 〈snas lta bur in ji'i skad yig gi mkhyen tshadkyang legs 4 yod 'dug la/ khong gis skabs der in ji bas bzung ba'i rgya gar dang / abgha ni si than/ bal yul/ shri laṅka bcas su dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i 'ordzo rabs sum cu'i nang du'grim 'grul mang po byas yod/ khong gis lo bcu gnyis ring 'grim 'grul byas pa'i rjes tsamla brtsams pa'i gsung rtsom de (rgyal khams rig pas bskor pa'i gtam rgyud gser gyi thangma) ngos kyis thog mar mthong skabs ngo mtshar chen po skyes byung / der nang chos dang deng duskyi tshan rig dbar sde tshan mang yo zhig gi thog grub 'bras ldan pa'i bgro slong 'byung thub skorgsungs 〈snad/ ya mtshan pa zhig la dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis thugs snang byung ba gang mangzhig ngas do snang byung ba dang gcig mtshungs su 'dug 'on kyang blo pham pa zhig la de snga gsung rtsomder dgos nges kyi do snang byed mkhan byung med/ de'i rgyu mtshan gcig ni phyi lo 1959 lor nga skyabsbcol du ma 'gyor gong 'od du dpar skrun tshad ldan zhig byung mi 'dug yin na yang nga tshan rig gi'dzam gling nang 'grul bzhud ma byas gong / ngos nyid kyi 'od pa'i srol rgyun rang gi nang nas tshan rtsalkhrod gom bgrod gnang mkhan zhig byung 'dug pa de ni ha cang dga' slobs skye 'os pa zhig yin/ lhagpar du khong nga rang gi skye yul a mdo rang nas phebs pa zhig kyang red/ gsung rtsom de bris nas lo mang de 'dra zhig gi rjes nga'i lag par thog mar 'phyor skabs sems tshor chen po zhig skyes byung /
51lo shas tsam gyi gong a ri'i bud med 'od mir gnyen sgrig byas pa zhig dang blo g.yeng dgos pa'i skad cha zhig byung ba yang dran gyi 'dug khong gis nga tshan rig la do snang yod pa dang / tshan rig pa dang mnyame du bgro gleng shugs che byed kyi yod pa thos stabs/ mos nang chos 'tsho gnas byed par tshan rig gis nyen kha bzo bas yid gzab dgos pa dang / tshan rig ni chos med par bzo mkhan yin pa lo rgyus kyi rgyab rten yod pas/ tā la'i bla mas mu mthud de 'dir gtogs kyi tshan rig ched mkhas mi sna de dag la 'grogs 'dris bya rgyu de legs yo zhig min zhes bshad byung / mo'i lta tshul ltar na tshan rig nang nga sger gyi 'grul bzhud byas pa de ha lam rang gi mjing pa gzhan la rtsis sprod byas pa lta bu chags yod/ nga tshan rig nang de ltar zhugs rgyu'i slobs pa ni/ tshan rig ltar sangs rgyas pa'i chos su yang / dngos yo'i gnas lugs rtogs pa ni rtog dpyod zhib mo'i sgo nas byed kyi 'dug snyam pa'i nga'i gzhi rtsa'i yid ches de la brten nas byung / gal te tshan rig gi dpyad thabs brgyud nas nang chos kyi 'dod tshul kha shas nor 'khrul yin pa mtha' skyel thub na/ nga tshos nges par tshan rig gi gsar rnyed grub don de khas blangs nas rang re'i dam bca' nor ba rnams spang dgos pa yin/nga rang sems gting nas rgyal spyi'i ring lugs pa zhig yin pa'i cha nas tshan rig par yid smon dang / sems 'gul thebs byed kyi shugs rkyen che lhags shig ni/ khong tshos rgyal mtshams la 'dzems zon med par yid dang ba chen pos rang rang gi shes yon phan tshun mnyam spyod byed pa de yin/ srid don gyi cha nas 'dzam gling de ches nyen tshabs che ba'i phyogs gtogs kyi rtse mor son pa'i grang dmag gi skabs su yang / shar nub sder gtogs kyi tshan rig pa rnams chab srid pa tsho'i bsam blor yang shong dka' ba'i 'brel ba byed 'dod yod pa shes tshor byung / des na khong tshor 'gro ba mi'i rigs rnams gcig gyur yin pa'i ngos 'dzin dang / shes yon thad sger sdom mkhregs 'dzin mi byed par gu yangs su spyod pa'i gnad don zhig yod pa shes rtogs byung /ngas tshan rig la do snang byas pa'i rgyu rkyen de sger gyi gnas tshul tsam ma yin/ skyabs bcol du ma 'byor gong nas sod nang chab srid thog nyams chag byung rkyen gcig ni/ deng rabs kyi bcos bsgyur la sgo mo phye ma thub par lus pas yin pa nga dang sod na yod pa gzhan rnams
tsha11kyis shes gsal yin/ rgya gar du 'byor ma thag nga tshos 'od phrug skyabs bcol pa tsho'i ched sod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus nang ches thog mar chags pa'i tshan rig slob sgyong the ba'i deng dus kyi slob tshan yod pa'i slob grwa gsar 'dzugs byas pa yin/ de dus ngas deng rabs kyi snying yo ni tshan rig ngo spyod bya rgyu yin pa ngos 'dzin thub pa byung zhing / deng dus kyi slob tshan gyi snying sor tshan rig dang 'phrul rig la byang chub pa zhig nges par dgos pa gsal rtogs byung / shes yon las gzhi der ngos sger gyi chod sems de ltar yod stabs/ so so'i las 'gan gtso 'o gna' rabs kyi nang chos lta grub slob gnyer byed sa'i dgon sde'i mtho rim slob gnyer khang khag tu'ang / so so'i slob tshan nang tshan rig skor ngo sprod dgos pa'i skul ma byas pa yin/ngos kyi tshan rig go rtogs je mthor phyin pa'i skabs gzugs can gyi 'jig rten shes rtogs thad nga tsho'i gna' rabs kyi nang pa'i gzhung lugs khag gi 'grel bshad dang /rnam gzhag mang 4 zhig deng dus kyi tshan rig dang bsdur na rags pa yin pa gsal yor shes byung / yin yang de dang chabs cig tshan rig gi yar rgyas ches mthon yor son pa'i rgyal khab tsho'i nang du'ang 'gro ba mi rnams sdug bsngal spyi dang / lhag par du nang sems kyi myong tshor dang 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal mu mthud myong bzhin pa gsal por mthong / tshan rig gi phan thogs che 〈snas ni phyi lus dang 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal nyung du gtong bar zhabs 'degs chen 4 zhig sgrub thub/ de lta na'ang sems tshor dang 'brel ba'i sdug bsngal de dag gi gdong len dang / de med par bzo ba ni mi'i nang sems kyi lta stangs bsgyur bcos dang / brtse sems sesnags rim bzhin spel ba kho na'i sgo nas bsgrub dgos/ des na nga tshos rang nyid kyi gzhi rtsa'i bde skyed 'tshol skabs/ mi'i rigs kyi rin thang che ba'i gzhi rtsa'i bzang spyod gong 'phel gtong rgyu ni med thabs med pa zhig yin/ des na mi'i rigs kyi bde thabs cha nas bltas na'ang tshan rig dang sems don rig pa gnyis 'brel med cig gtan nas min/ nga tshos lus sems gnyis lnga'i steng gi sdug bsngal sel dgos par brten nga tshor de gnyis ka dgos/deb 'di tshan rig dang ngas phran bu'i zab tsam shes rtogs yod pa'i nang chos lta bu'i sems don rig pa gnyis gcig tu bzo ched 'bad brtson byas pa zhig min pas nga tsho'i mtha' 'khor du yod pa'i dngos su mthong thub min ci rigs kyi 'dzam gling 'di phyogs yongs nas
shes rtogs yong slad/ mi'i rigs kyi shes bya'i sde tshan che khag gnyis nas rgyab rten rgyu mtshasna 111dang bcas pa'i bden dpang gsar rnyed byung ba rnams bad spyod byas te/ bden don gting zab cig 'tshol zhib byed slad bris pa yin/ ngas 'dir nang chos dang tshan rig gnyis kyi mthun sa dang mi mthun sa'i gnad don gal chen khag mkhas pa'i nyams zhib dang / mtha' dasprungad bya rgyur brtson pa zhig min/ de ni ched las mkhas dbang tshos gnang na legs pas khong rnam pa'i ched 'jog rgyu yin/ nga'i bsam par sems don rig pa dang tshan rig gnyis tha dad yin yang /gal che'i bden don 'tshol ba gcig mtshungs yin pas phan tshun kha skyong byed pa'i zhib dpyod kyi thabs lam zhig yin/ de'i thad phan tshun gcig gis gcig nas sbyongang da〈snas pa mang yo zhig yod la/ de gnyis zung 'brel gyis mi'i rigs kyi shes yon dang / blo gros kyi rwa ba rgya bskyed gtong bar zhabs 'degs zhu thub/ lhag par sde tshan 'di gnyis phan tshun bgro gleng brgyud/ tshan rig dang sems don rig pa gnyis ka gong 'phel du phyin pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba mi'i dgos mkho dang / bde thabs la zhabs 'degs legs par sgrub thub pa'i yid ches 〈snad/ gzhan yang ngas rang nyid tshan rig la do snang dang / der 'grul bzhud kyi lo rgyus bshad pa 'dis 'dzam gling khyon yongs kyi nang pa'i spun zla sa ya mang ṭo yod pa tshor/ tshan rig de gal che don cher brtsis te des gsar rnyed gzhi rkang rnams rang nyid kyi 'dzam gling lta tshul nang ngos len dgos pa'i skul ma bya rgyu yin/tshan rig dang sems don rig pa'i bar gyi bgro gling 'dir lo rgyus ring so zhig yod/lhag par du ye shu'i chos lugs dang mnyam du lo rgyus de ltar yod/ nga rang gi 'od kyi nang pa'i chos brgyud la mtshon na lo rgyus dang / sgyi tshogs/ chab srid la serdzogs pa'i gnad don 'dra min mang ṭo zhig gi dbang gis tshan rig gi 'dzam gling lta tshul dang 'brel ba cha tshang ba zhig yong rgyu de dus da lta'ang gsar du 'go 'dzugs byas pa tsam zhig red/ tshan rig gis nus shugs ji m+wa zhig ster min ni da lta'ang cha tshang gsal so zhig chags med/ sger so so'i tshan rig skor bsam tshul mi 'dra ba ci yod la ma ltos par ngas deb 'di'i nang / 'dzam gling lta tshul zhes pa'i tha snyad de zad spyodad byas pa'i 'jug yul rang bzhin gyi 'dzam gling ngam/ nga tsho 'gro ba mi'i 'tsho gnas thad yid ches 'pher ba'i bosna rtogs shig rnyed par gal che'i tshan rig gi rnam gzhag gi
517rigs/ dper na/ 'phel 'gyur/ lhos grub rig pa/ tshad rdul shugs rig la sogs pa de dag gi gzhi rtsa'i blo skyed rnams snang chung bskyur 'grog byed thabs med/ sems don rig pa dang go sdur byas pa dang / lhag par du mi'i blang dor gyi spyod tshul nas sgyi tshogs bar gyi 'phro ba mi'i rgya khyab che ba'i gnad don dang / phan tshun 'brel mthud kyis tshan rig la blo skyed 'byung srid kyang /nang chos kyi 'jig rten rnam gzhag dang dngos khams rags pa'i lta tshul lta bu'i lta tshul rnying pa'i rigs 'ga' zhig ni/ tshan rig gi gsar rnyed kyi blo skyed la brten nas bcos bsgyur gong mthor gtong dgos/ deb 'di tshan rig dang sems don rig pa'i dbar gyi bkro gling gson nyams ldan par bzo ba'i gal 'gangs che ba'i las gzhi de'i zhabs 'degs su 'gro ba'i re ba yod/nga'i dmigs yul da lta'i 'dzam gling gi gnad don zab gnad che zugs rnams 'tshol zhib bya rgyu yin stabs rgya che'i mang tshogs gang mang zhig dang 'brel ba byed 'dod byas pa yin/de ni las sla po zhig min te mtshams rer tshan rig
